title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member V
Scrum Master - AVP
description:
Join us as a Scrum Master \- AVP at Barclays, where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting\-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
   

  

 To be successful as a Scrum Master \- AVP, you should have experience with:
   

  

  

* Strong understanding of Scaled Agile and Scrum practices.
* Excellent Communication \& Stakeholder Facilitation.
* Familiarity with Agile Tooling (JIRA) \& Reporting Practices.
* Ability to Work Across Multi‑disciplinary, Distributed POD Structures.
* Ability to take e2e accountability of team delivering a quality product increment in every release.
* Ability to provide situational servant leadership to the team.
* Ability to manage complex projects in banking at enterprise scale.


**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**
* Proven experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Delivery Lead.
* Strong understanding of Agile frameworks (Scrum, SAFe).
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and coaching teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience managing risks, issues, and dependencies.


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 The role is based out of Pune.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 Facilitates and supports Agile teams by ensuring they follow Scrum principles. To remove obstacles, enhance team collaboration, and ensure smooth communication, enabling the team to focus on delivering high\-quality, iterative results. Facilitate Scrum events, promote continuous improvement, and act as a bridge between the team and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Facilitate Events: Facilitate events, as needed, and ensure that all events take place and are positive, productive, and kept within the timebox
* Support Iteration Execution: Ensure quality of ceremony artefacts and continuous customer value through iteration execution, maintain backlog refinement, and iterate on stakeholder feedback
* Optimize Flow: Identify and facilitate the removal of conflict impacting team flow, utilizing metrics to empower the team to communicate effectively, making all work visible
* Mitigate Risks: Identify and escalate risks to remove impediments and shield the Squad from interruptions
* Build High\-Performing Teams: Foster and coach Agile Team attributes and continuous improvement, encourage stakeholder collaboration, deputise ‘in the moment leadership’, and drive high\-performing team attributes
* Stakeholder Management: Facilitate stakeholder collaboration (e.g., business stakeholders, product teams, vendors) and build trust with stakeholders
* Governance and Reporting: Ensure data quality and provide representation at required governance forums, if applicable


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
   

  

 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
   

  

 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
   

  

 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
   

  

 Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
   

  

 Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
   

  

 Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
   

  

 Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
   

  

 Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
   

  

 Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
   

  

 Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
   

  

 Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.
   

  

 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Engineering Manager - Core Commerce Platform
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
   

  

**YOUR MISSION:**
* About the Organisation \& Role:


 You will be part of the Consumer Intelligence \& Engagement organisation responsible for delivering the intelligence and engagement capabilities that enable more relevant and personalised consumer experiences across digital channels. The organisation plays a key role in how consumers discover products, engage with content, and elevate experiences through membership \& loyalty. Through capabilities such as personalisation, recommendations, consumer intelligence, experimentation, and AI\-driven decisioning, the organisation helps deliver more contextual, data\-driven interactions across the consumer journey.
   

  

 The Engineering Manager is accountable for engineering delivery, roadmap execution, operational excellence, and engineering team development. Partnering with Product Owners, Data Engineering \& Analytics, Tech Leads, and peer engineering teams, you will enable predictable delivery, grow engineering talent, and build a high\-performing culture focused on ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.
   

  

* Drive planning and execution against team objectives and key results (OKRs), ensuring alignment, accountability and transparent reporting.
* Own sprint execution, delivery planning, capacity management, dependency management, and risk management.
* Partner with Product Owners, Project Managers, Retail Tech team, and Tech Leads to deliver business outcomes.
* Ensure inventory availability, delivery promise, and omnichannel capabilities are reliable, accurate, and scalable across channels.
* Drive engineering excellence through strong development practices, quality standards, operational discipline and continuous improvement.
* Coach engineers through regular feedback, mentoring, performance management, and career development.
* Build a high\-performing engineering culture focused on ownership, accountability, collaboration, and learning.
* Establish effective engineering metrics and use data to improve team productivity, quality, and delivery predictability.
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices and automation to improve productivity, quality, and delivery efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI across software development, testing, documentation, knowledge management and onboarding.
* Collaborate with engineering leadership on hiring, staffing, onboarding, talent development, and succession planning.


 Manage delivery partners and vendors where applicable and ensure alignment with team objectives.
   

  

**YOUR TALENT:**
* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, with experience leading engineering teams in an agile delivery environment.
* 3\+ years of people leadership experience.
* Strong experience leading roadmap execution, delivery planning, dependency management, and stakeholder engagement.
* Solid software engineering background with experience building APIs, distributed systems, and integration\-heavy platforms.
* Familiarity with API\-first, cloud\-native architectures and design patterns.
* Familiarity with Order Management, Inventory Management platforms.
* Experience working with event\-driven architectures, high\-volume transactional systems, and enterprise integrations.
* Strong people leadership skills with experience in hiring, mentoring, developing, and retaining high\-performing engineering teams.
* Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices including software architecture \& engineering principles, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, and AI\-assisted development.
* Strong communication, collaboration, decision\-making, and organisational leadership skills.
* Experience driving engineering quality, operational excellence, reliability, security, and continuous improvement.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira \& Confluence or equivalent.
* A data\-driven mindset with the ability to use engineering, delivery, and operational metrics to improve team effectiveness and predictability.
* Experience leveraging coding agents, LLMs, and AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and team productivity will be a strong advantage.
* Experience in eCommerce is preferred.


 PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
   

  

 At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
   

  

 PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

title: Scrum Master / Senior Consultant Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Consultant Specialist
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead Agile delivery as Scrum Master across Scrum and/or SAFe teams, coaching on Agile principles, ceremonies, and ways of working.
* Plan and facilitate Sprint (and where applicable PI) events, ensuring goals are clear, realistic, and protected from scope drift.
* Build and maintain integrated delivery plans covering milestones, dependencies, risks, assumptions, constraints, blockers, and critical path.
* Remove impediments proactively by coordinating across engineering, QA, architecture, environments, release management, and third parties/vendors.
* Coordinate sprints, releases, and cross\-team dependencies, keeping delivery aligned to wider programme timelines and outcomes.
* Own delivery tracking and reporting in JIRA and Confluence, including dashboards, sprint metrics, burn\-down/up, velocity trends, RAID, and executive\-ready status reporting.
* Drive delivery to challenging timelines via prioritisation, capacity planning, and risk\-based decision\-making, escalating early when needed.
* Own delivery governance for releases and change: manage ServiceNow CRs, CAB readiness, release notes/communications, test sign\-offs, ITSA/eITSA, and ensure audit\-ready artefacts (evidence, approvals, runbooks, rollback plans).


**To Be Successful, You Will**
* Have proven Scrum Master experience in an Agile delivery environment (Scrum and/or SAFe), with strong coaching and facilitation capability.
* Bring strong planning and dependency management skills, able to connect team\-level execution to programme\-level milestones and critical path.
* Be hands\-on with JIRA and Confluence, able to create meaningful dashboards, maintain RAID, and produce clear, consistent status reporting for senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrate a track record of removing impediments quickly, navigating across engineering, QA, architecture, environments, release/change, and vendors.
* Have release/change governance experience, including ServiceNow CRs, CAB processes, and producing/maintaining evidence for audit and control expectations.
* Show excellent stakeholder management and communication, able to drive alignment and set expectations on scope, schedule, and risk.
* Apply strong delivery discipline through prioritisation, capacity planning, metrics, and early escalation grounded in delivery data.
* Have a continuous improvement mindset, using retrospectives, action tracking, and team health checks to improve flow efficiency, predictability, and collaboration.


 You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
   

  

 www.hsbc.com/careers
   

  

 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Lead Software Release Manager
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Lead Software Release Manager
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Software Release Manager to lead end\-to\-end release planning, scheduling, and orchestration across a portfolio of 7\-8 interconnected software products and platforms. This role is responsible for establishing and maintaining an integrated release calendar that balances product roadmaps, engineering capacity, testing environment availability, customer commitments, regulatory requirements, and cross\-program dependencies.
   

  

 The ideal candidate thrives in complex enterprise environments where multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders must coordinate to successfully deliver high\-quality software releases. This individual will serve as the central point of coordination for release readiness, dependency management, environment planning, and deployment execution.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Release Planning \& Scheduling
   

  

* Own the enterprise release calendar across 7\-8 products and platforms.
* Develop and maintain integrated release schedules accounting for:
* Development milestones
* Integration testing windows
* Pre\-production validation
* Performance and scalability testing
* Production deployment windows
* Customer onboarding and certification timelines
* Coordinate release trains and major program increments across multiple teams.
* Balance competing priorities while optimizing release frequency and stability.


 Dependency Management
   

  

* Identify, document, track, and proactively manage:
* Product\-to\-product dependencies
* Program\-to\-program dependencies
* Infrastructure dependencies
* Vendor and external partner dependencies
* Customer readiness dependencies
* Facilitate dependency review forums and drive cross\-functional alignment.
* Resolve schedule conflicts and escalation issues impacting release delivery.


 Environment \& Capacity Management
   

  

* Govern utilization of critical testing and deployment environments, including:
* Integration environments
* System testing environments
* UAT environments
* Performance testing environments
* Pre\-production environments
* Production environments
* Coordinate environment reservations and conflict resolution across multiple teams.
* Ensure environment readiness, availability, and release sequencing.


 Release Readiness \& Governance
   

  

* Establish release entry and exit criteria.
* Conduct release readiness reviews and go/no\-go assessments.
* Verify completion of:
* Functional testing
* Integration testing
* Regression testing
* Performance testing
* Security validation
* Operational readiness activities
* Ensure change management and release governance processes are followed.


 Stakeholder Coordination
   

  

* Partner closely with:
* Engineering teams
* Product Managers
* Program Managers
* Quality Engineering teams
* Site Reliability Engineering teams
* Infrastructure teams
* Customer delivery teams
* Operations and Support organizations
* Communicate release plans, risks, constraints, and status to both technical and executive audiences.
* Drive alignment across globally distributed teams.


 Risk \& Issue Management
   

  

* Identify schedule, environment, resource, and operational risks early.
* Develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Lead release war rooms for major deployments.
* Track and drive resolution of release blockers and critical dependencies.


 Metrics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Define and monitor release management KPIs, including:
* Release predictability
* On\-time delivery
* Deployment success rate
* Environment utilization
* Defect leakage
* Change failure rate
* Continuously improve release planning processes, tooling, and governance.


**All About You**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 8\+ years of experience in software delivery, technical program management, release management, or engineering operations.
* 5\+ years managing enterprise\-scale software releases.
* Experience coordinating releases across multiple products and engineering teams simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of:
* SDLC
* Agile and Scrum methodologies
* DevOps practices
* CI/CD pipelines
* Change and release management processes
* Demonstrated experience managing complex dependency chains and cross\-functional delivery programs.
* Strong project planning, organization, and risk\-management skills.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder\-management capabilities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in large\-scale distributed systems or payment\-processing platforms.
* Experience coordinating releases across globally distributed teams.
* Working knowledge of tools such as:
* Jira
* Azure DevOps
* GitHub Actions
* Jenkins
* XL Release / Digital.ai Release
* Splunk
* Confluence
* PMP, PMI\-ACP, SAFe, ITIL, or DevOps certifications.
* Experience supporting highly regulated or mission\-critical production environments.


 Success Measures
   

  

**A Successful Software Release Manager Will**
* Maintain a synchronized release schedule across 7\-8 products with minimal conflicts.
* Improve release predictability and on\-time delivery.
* Reduce environment contention and resource bottlenecks.
* Ensure all customer, platform, program, and infrastructure dependencies are proactively managed.
* Deliver production releases with high deployment success rates and low operational impact.
* Provide leadership visibility into release health, risks, and readiness.


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
